preliminary_findings: A preliminary bounded matrix product failed because the over-nesting expected return-statement span omitted its final newline. That expectation was corrected and the final complete matrix passed. A copied-error assignment path was also completed and covered by a real source fixture before the final run.
Initial checker compile failed until the v2 overlap helper visibility was corrected.
Internal engine test construction needed borrowed arena/session/evidence references after the single-session refactor.
Test expectations were corrected for complete block spans, parser CGS106 negative-budget rejection, a dynamic-budget byte span, and checked integer arithmetic wording.

The first outer harness incorrectly applied its log file-size cap to compiler artifacts (SIGXFSZ); it now monitors logs directly. Its RUSTC wrapper was incompatible with Clippy and was replaced by a linker RUSTFLAGS setting.
A copied security policy fixture accidentally used schema 2; the fixture was restored to supported policy schema 1. No host policy changed.

A package no_gc rejection expectation changed from CGM001 to CGT080 because ordinary copied-result guards now select the authenticated profile. Explicit Unit/effects legacy admission remains on its original path.
One workspace attempt hit the pre-existing fake-solver test: MalformedResponse rather than Unsat. Isolated rerun and subsequent complete workspace runs passed without verifier changes.

Sandbox startup failed with EDQUOT before commands. The first read-only escalation review timed out; retry succeeded. Final commands ran outside that unavailable sandbox, using private build/temp directories and offline dependencies.

A later disk-quota failure prevented a new matrix log from opening. Only this task incremental cache was removed; no source truncation was found. The attempted guard-only legacy body retained its original CGM001 rejection, not a guard-entry success.
The explicit version separation initially left one internal engine test using the v1 model; it was switched to compile_source_v2 and the compatibility tests passed.
